column1: 9.5.1 A Model of the Small Open Economy Suppose there are two countries. The home country is denoted by the superscript h, and the foreign country by the superscript f . The countries share the same preferences and technologies. Both produce traded consumption goods that are imperfect substitutes in utility. The foreign country is a stand-in for the rest of the world, and the home country is small relative to the foreign country.
